plan.title: Saved eRFX draft hides Buy Template when vendor locking is Off

steps.note: Open the eRFX project creation screen.
Enable eRFX project creation for the draft.
Apply the additional configuration specified by the case.
Give the draft the required project title.
Apply a template so the draft has a valid configured stage.
Add the required line item to the draft.
Complete the pricing sheet for the draft line item.
Commit a schedule so the draft can be saved.
Save the configured eRFX project as a draft.
Confirm the draft save did not produce an application error.
Return to the events list to locate the saved draft.
Verify this plan's saved draft appears in the Drafts tab.
Reopen this plan's draft on its create screen.
Assert that Buy Template is not offered on the saved eRFX draft.
